purpose: Teach: 役に立ち/即時/役場/強固/着信/インセンティブ/力量/上京

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手の研究、業界に、役に立ちそうな提案、見守ろう、期待だな。
lines.en: Youth research and industry-applicable proposals—let's keep watching. That's where my expectations are.
lines.style: Measured, slightly forward-leaning in seat. Clear enunciation on key nouns. Thoughtful pause before 'that's where.' Quiet conviction that settles the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要案件、即時、対応するよう、社員に、徹底しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've made sure the staff understands—urgent matters get immediate attention.
lines.style: Crisp, businesslike. Direct eye contact. Affirming nod on 'yes.' Clipped pace on the second half—showing competence without elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地元の役場、行政書類、いつまでも、紙文化、続いているな。
lines.en: The local municipal office still clings to paper documents. That culture's harder to shift than you'd think.
lines.style: Slight exhale of wry observation. Lean back. Knowing tone—not complaining, just noting an old institutional habit. Trailing inflection like 'such is the way.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組合との関係、強固なものに、しております、対話、続けて。
lines.en: Yes. We're building a stronger relationship with the union—dialogue continues on all fronts.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Each clause deliberate. Warm undertone—showing this partnership matters. Not rushing past 'continues.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様からの着信、最優先で、対応しろ。
lines.en: Calls from our key clients need to be our top priority. Make sure that's clear.
lines.style: Firmer edge. Sits forward slightly. Command is gentle but unmistakable. Slight weight on 'top priority'—not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、業績連動インセンティブ、来期から、導入予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to introduce performance-linked incentives for staff starting next term.
lines.style: Straightforward, methodical. Slight lift on 'planning'—showing initiative. Measured pace throughout. Confident without over-selling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部長の力量、信頼に値するな、引き続き、伸ばさせろ。
lines.en: The department head has the competence to earn that trust. Keep developing that strength.
lines.style: Approving warmth beneath the surface. Deliberate pacing. Light emphasis on 'competence'—quiet praise. Closes with a directive that feels like encouragement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方支社の社員、上京して、本社研修、受けています、今週。
lines.en: Yes. Our local branch staff are in Tokyo this week for headquarters training.
lines.style: Brief, factual. Brisk delivery. Professional completion of the update. Small beat before 'this week'—marking it as current, active.
